mapper.insert: INSERT INTO residents (unit_id, name, phone, id_card, type, move_in_date, status) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{type}, #{moveInDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE residents SET unit_id=#{unitId}, name=#{name}, phone=#{phone}, id_card=#{idCard}, type=#{type}, move_in_date=#{moveInDate}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
